answer: Every new key must post a sable-pelt bond, a scarce good whose market tape the protocol watches, then clear a single-file enrollment jetty before its pin appears on the public atlas of eligible agents. The jetty records think-time, funding lot, and answer cadence. Pins funded by the same pelt shipment or sharing cadence are slashed together and the pelts burned. A sybil farmer has to buy N separately sourced sable lots at rising spot prices and wait through N serial jetty admissions they cannot parallelize.
